groups.title: Limitations of an SDE
groups.text: Limitations of an SDE Stochastic term means: ● Slower solver. Need 1000-2000 steps because we don’t know in advance which region is “easy” vs. “hard”. ● More sources of error. Both discretization error from ﬁnite step sizes and injected stochastic noise
